title: My Grandparents
subtitle: 考点：周末活动 / I visit my grandparents on Sunday.

dialogue.t: Do you visit your grandparents at the weekend, Tom?
Yes, every Sunday. They live near my school.
In the afternoon I help my grandfather in the garden. In the evening my grandmother tells me stories.
That is lovely. I usually visit my grandparents on Saturday.
Yum! I want to try them.

vocab: visit 拜访 · grandparent 祖父母 · Sunday 星期日 · Saturday 星期六 · evening 晚上 · usually 通常
